AAFC Outlook for Principal Field Crops (Canada)

outlook: Grains were lower in Friday morning trade. December corn slipped to about $4.76, an eight-week low, as the October WASDE's bigger crop (181.2 bpa yield, 1.849 billion bushels of ending stocks) outweighed a slower harvest pace. November soybeans eased to about $12.60 and are headed for a weekly loss, as expectations for a record U.S. harvest and a weaker-than-expected NOPA crush report offset roughly 1.2–1.5 million tonnes of Chinese buying this week. Winter wheat fell hardest, with Chicago December down 9 cents to $6.61 on reports of a much larger Australian crop, while Minneapolis December spring wheat was nearly unchanged near $6.86; ICE November canola settled Thursday at C$801.70, down C$10.
